note: Measured by tests/grainline.test.ts on Node. Speed 1 is the casual setting, speed 2 a broadcast final.
rerun: npm test (runs tests/grainline.test.ts, which recomputes every number below and fails on any difference).

seeds.roundPrng: mulberry32(seed), the house test PRNG from tests/determinism.ts

random.description: Ignores the glyph: uniform angle, swipes 6–60 ticks after it appears.

greedy.description: Reads the grain sloppily: ±32°, 15% misreads, 22–55 ticks.

expert.description: Reads the grain from the screen, ±8°, reacts 12–18 ticks (never under 200 ms).

topEnd.why: Prize rounds share a seed; experts must separate rather than tie at a ceiling.

bars.source: Provisional bars from canon BUILD step 5, until G3 sets real ones.
